correctness.rationale: PASS: The published P(m,2) is the truncated box [0,2]^m∩{Σx_i≤3} with precisely 0, 2e_i and 2e_i+e_j (i!=j) as vertices. For proposed center t_m1 and Q=u_m H+v_m(I−H), direct orbit gauges equal q(0)=q(B)=1 and q(A)=1 up to m=5, then q(A)=1−4(m−5)(m+1)/(9m(5m−9))<1 for m>=6. Independent Sympy factorization verified for BOTH rational regimes and symbolic variable m all mass=1, E[X]=t_m1, radial and transverse covariance identities m Cov(X)=Q; m=5 formulas coincide. All weights nonnegative in their stated integer domains. Averaging any enclosing ellipsoid quadratic form over the contact probability measure gives tr(R^{-1}Q)/m<=1; determinant AM–GM forces det(R)>=det(Q), equality only at same center and Q, proving global unique Löwner ellipsoid (not just symmetric competitors). Universal statement relies on symbolic identities, not finite verifier dimensions.
